title: Successor play update
statement: For any two strategies assigning a Boolean move to each finite Boolean history and any natural number $r$, the history after $r+1$ moves is obtained by applying one single-move update to the history after $r$ moves, using the first player's strategy at even-length histories and the second player's strategy at odd-length histories.
